readings: Which circuits have hosted an above-average share of races? For each circuit (`races.circuitId`), give its number of races, its share of all races (its count divided by the total across all circuits), and how far that share is above the average circuit's share. Show the top 10 by that margin, largest first.
queries:
SELECT circuitId,
       COUNT(*) AS race_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) FROM races) AS margin
FROM races
GROUP BY circuitId
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
